title: Cyclic invariance of a root-of-unity orbit product
statement: Let w be a positive natural number, let ζ ∈ ℂ satisfy ζ^w = 1, and let A : ℂ → ℂ be any function. Define P(t) = ∏_{j=0}^{w−1} A(ζ^j t). Then P(ζt) = P(t) for every complex number t.
lean_statement: ∀ (w : ℕ) (ζ : ℂ) (A : ℂ → ℂ), 0 < w → ζ ^ w = 1 → let P : ℂ → ℂ := fun t => ∏ j ∈ Finset.range w, A (ζ ^ j * t); ∀ t : ℂ, P (ζ * t) = P t
